Hey Product Hunt 👋 Andriana here, co-founder of kōdlo🐍  
  
The Problem. Selling a complex product takes hours of prep. You jump between a few disconnected tools to research accounts, draft personalized outreach, and assemble pitch decks. Context gets lost, and you end up spending more time on prep than talking to buyers.  
  
The Solution. kōdlo is an end-to-end sales workspace that keeps the context for you. Find prospects, research them, and write messages, proposals and decks in one place. Everything you do there, from research and notes to your documents and past conversations, stays in kōdlo's memory, so each new piece of work builds on what it already knows. [...] Subscribe

Launch tags:Sales•SaaS•Artificial Intelligence [...] What makes it different? kōdlo is built on one shared memory that every agent can use. The agent also sees what you see. Chat sits on the left, your work on the right. On top of that sits everything you need to sell: prospecting, research, your own knowledge base, outreach, decks, a task tracker, team collaboration and scheduled work.   
  
Key features:  
🎯 Find prospects with a reason. Describe who you sell to and kōdlo finds matching companies and decision makers. Each one comes with evidence for why it fits, like a funding round, a job ad or a line on their website.  
🔍 Deep search. Research on any company, market or person, written up as a report where every claim links to its source.

People already sell with their own AI every day. What they re missing is the context. k dlo keeps everything about your leads in one place, so it doesn t matter if you work in Claude, ChatGPT or a coding agent. That context goes with you, and the selling you already do just gets bigger. On top of that, k dlo gives you what a chat window can t, a real place to list your leads, sort them into campaigns and work on docs and everything else a deal needs.
